notablePrerequisites:
You control an indestructible creature that has With Great Power... attached to it.
You have a way to deal damage to the indestructible creature.
description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting the indestructible creature with With Great Power... attached.
Deal damage to the indestructible creature.
The creature triggers, dealing that much damage to each other creature and each player, with the damage that would be dealt to you instead being dealt to the indestructible creature due to With Great Power....
Repeat step 3.
